about: Lien histories written by an outside author who never saw the design (LIENS-SET-1, 2026-11-19): 30 ordinary files, 30 where the account changes during enforcement, 20 adversarial. Each item keeps the author's expected handling and its must-not as its opinion. The label is set by hand in the gate's own terms against the Florida facts below: the step asked, the decision, why, the effects that must follow, the records that must never exist, and the build part whose code decides it. When a timeline asks to sell and no approval is on record, the first gate it meets is the approval. Only open_lien_case, approve_lien_case and record_lien_address are command names today (overlock is a collections command); the other asks are placeholders named for what they do, until their part names its command. Labelled on 2026-11-19, after part 1's code existed and before it was run on any of them; parts 2 to 5 were not built.

florida: notice delivered in person, by e-mail, or by first-class mail with a certificate of mailing, and conspicuously posted at the facility or on the unit

e-mail only where the rental agreement allows it; with no answer, return receipt or delivery confirmation from that address, notice also goes by first-class mail with a certificate of mailing before the sale

the notice itemizes the claim, describes the property, demands payment within a stated time of at least 14 days after delivery, says the property will be advertised and sold at a stated time and place, and names the owner with an address and phone
after the notice's time runs out, an advertisement once a week for two consecutive weeks in a newspaper of general circulation
the sale at least 15 days after the first publication
a titled motor vehicle or watercraft has its own timing and title steps
money left after the sale is held for the tenant, who is told in person or by first-class mail with a certificate of mailing
policy.note: the owner's schedule is his setting, never law; the Florida lines restate the statute facts the design checked (sections 83.801 to 83.809) and are not legal advice
rules: rent and late fees billing posts on the signed schedule after the notice join the claim and do not send the file to review (the lien covers charges present or future, 83.805; the notice shows the sum due at its own time, 83.806(2)(a)); a charge posted by hand, a payment, a return, a waiver, an address change or a payment applied to another unit does

evidence rule (the file's own, not the statute): a notice, a mailing, a hand-delivery, an e-mail delivery, a posting and an advertisement each count only with the fingerprint of their document; an advertisement's document is the publisher's proof

asks.open_lien_case: open a lien case on what is due now (part 1)
asks.approve_lien_case: a manager approves the file as it stands; a request to sell with no approval on record meets this gate first (part 1)
asks.accept_payment: a payment the processor confirmed lands on a file after its notice (part 1)
asks.mark_paid: record money as received without a processor confirmation (books: refused everywhere)
asks.count_as_hold: treat a message as a hold on the steps (part 1)
asks.accept_notice: the file counts the notice's content as complete under the Florida rule version (part 2)
asks.count_notice_delivered: the file counts the notice as delivered under the Florida rule version (part 2)
asks.count_publication: the file counts the advertisements under the Florida rule version (part 2)
asks.start_sale: the approved sale goes ahead on the simulated auction platform (part 3)
asks.finalize_sale: the sale becomes final after bidding (part 3)
asks.record_sale_result: record what the auction ended with (part 3)
asks.cancel_listing: ask the platform to withdraw the listing (part 3)
asks.confirm_cancellation: record the listing as withdrawn (part 3: only on the platform's read-back)
asks.close_lien_case: close the case while a listing exists (part 3)
asks.release_contents: hand the contents to the buyer (parts 3 and 4)
asks.settle_sale_money: apply sale money to the claim and its costs (part 4)
asks.notify_surplus: tell the tenant about money left after the sale (part 4)
asks.reduce_surplus: take a charge out of the surplus (part 4)
asks.post_surplus_to_income: book the surplus as the facility's income (part 4)
asks.record_lien_address: record a written address on the file (part 1)

why.too_early: the owner's schedule has not reached that step
why.evidence_missing: the proof the step needs is not on file
why.evidence_mismatch: a document on file does not match this tenant, unit, facility or what was delivered
why.notice_method: the notice went by a method the agreement or the rule does not allow
why.email_fallback: no answer came from the e-mail address and no first-class mailing with a certificate followed
why.notice_deadline: the notice gives fewer than 14 days to pay
why.notice_incomplete: the notice lacks a part the rule requires, or its total does not match its itemized charges
why.publication_timing: the advertisements are early, too few, not once a week for two consecutive weeks, or the sale is less than 15 days after the first
why.approval_void: the file changed after it was approved
why.review_required: the books changed after the notice copy, so staff review the file first
why.hold: a dispute, a plan in good standing, a plan waiting for staff, an exemption or a signed agreement holds the steps
why.legal_stop: a legal stop is open; no approval overrides it
why.payment_pending: a payment is still waiting for the processor's answer
why.not_confirmed: the outside system has not confirmed it
why.not_money: a bid, a claim of payment or a message is not money received
why.not_a_hold: an informal promise is not a hold
why.listing_cancelled: a cancelled listing never comes back
why.titled_property: a titled vehicle or watercraft needs its own review
why.wrong_unit: each unit has its own file, notice and advertisements
why.wrong_address: the notice went to an address the records had already replaced
why.sale_terms_changed: the sale date differs from the one the notice and the advertisements gave
why.surplus_protected: the surplus is owed to the tenant and no later fee reduces it
why.no_buyer: the auction ended with no buyer

effects.approval_tied_to_fingerprint: the approval names the file's fingerprint (part 1)
effects.frozen_for_staff: nothing moves until staff record a decision (part 1)
effects.review_required: the file goes to staff review (part 1)
effects.counsel_task: a task naming counsel review (part 2; part 1 gives the staff task)
effects.cured: the episode closes as cured and no enforcement step follows; a listing's cancellation stays its own open item until the platform's read-back (part 1)
effects.debt_reopened: the debt and a staff case reopen (part 4)
effects.cancellation_requested: a cancellation request goes to the platform (part 3)
effects.bid_recorded: the bid is recorded apart from money (part 3)
effects.applied:55000: $550.00 applied to the claim and costs (part 4)
effects.notice_to_current_address: the notice goes to the current verified address (part 4)
effects.proceeds_reversed: the sale money record is reversed (part 4)

never.approval_recorded: a lien_case approval event for this decision
never.approval_reused: a sale step allowed on an approval whose fingerprint no longer matches the file
never.auto_cancel_on_partial: the case closed or the listing cancelled only because a partial payment arrived
never.bid_as_money: a payment, credit or sale-money record made from a bid
never.cancellation_closed_while_listed: the listing's cancellation item marked done while the platform's last read-back shows the listing
never.cancellation_confirmed_without_readback: a cancellation recorded as confirmed with no platform read-back behind it
never.claim_full_recovery: the whole claim marked recovered when the money applied is less
never.claim_ignored: the claimed payment left with no record and no staff task
never.claim_old_balance: a notice, approval or sale step using a claim that leaves out a payment, return, waiver or charge the books now hold
never.claim_unexplained_amount: a claim amount above the itemized charges accepted
never.contents_released: a release of the contents recorded
never.deadline_invented: a payment deadline added to a notice that did not state one
never.dispute_erased: the dispute or its decision missing from the file's history
never.enforcement_continued: any enforcement step allowed after the claim was paid
never.evidence_edited: a stored evidence record changed or removed instead of superseded
never.hold_created_from_text: a hold, plan or promise record created only from the message
never.hold_overridden: a step allowed while the hold stands
never.historic_address_rewritten: an earlier address record changed, or the earlier mailing recorded at the new address
never.income_posted: an income entry made from money owed to the tenant or to a secured party
never.legal_guarantee_claimed: page or record text saying the sale is legally compliant or guaranteed
never.listing_revived: a cancelled listing set live again
never.marked_paid: a payment or a paid state recorded without the processor's confirmation
never.notice_delivered: the file counting the notice as delivered
never.old_address_used: the surplus notice sent to an address the records replaced
never.operative_date:Oct 18: the notice period counted from Oct 18
never.other_unit_included: another unit, or its debt, in this unit's notice, claim or sale
never.pending_as_failed: a payment still waiting for the processor treated as failed
never.proceeds_invented: a buyer, sale money or a sale confirmation recorded that the platform did not report
never.publication_counted_before:Nov 2: an advertisement dated on or before Nov 1 counted
never.publication_counted: the advertisements counted as meeting the rule
never.sale_approved: the sale approved or completed as a result of this step
never.sale_started: the sale step allowed to go ahead
never.stop_overridden: any step allowed while the legal stop is open
never.surplus_invented: a surplus recorded where the money applied does not exceed the claim and costs
never.surplus_reduced: the surplus lowered by a charge posted after the sale
never.task_as_proof: an internal task's done state taken as proof of an outside effect
never.waived_fee_claimed: the waived fee in a claim or a sale step

bar.scored: the decision, the effects the built parts provide, and the never records; why is guidance only, because the gate may name another true reason first
bar.pass: every item whose part is built gives the labelled decision and those effects, and no item leaves a never record
bar.critical: any never record in any item
bar.fixtures: the items are prose; each part's pull request turns its own items into fixtures on the books, and no result from this set is claimed before that
